name: Audit Trail File activity
description: Chains managed-file lifecycle events (create, update, made-permanent, delete, private-stream download) into the audit trail with dedicated action verbs.
project_description: Submodule of audit_trail. Subscribes to hook_file_insert / _update / _delete / _download and writes each managed-file event into the chained audit trail on channel audit_trail_file, keeping file-specific action verbs (file_created, file_updated, file_made_permanent on the temporary-to-permanent status flip, file_deleted, file_downloaded) instead of folding them into generic entity rows. Each event carries the file uri/filename/mime/size/status in transient context; resource is file:<fid>. Downloads are audited for the private:// stream only (public files are served by the web server and bypass Drupal); the shipped chain scopes file_downloaded to GET/HEAD via a request-method filter so non-byte-serving verbs do not emit rows. Per-event opt-in via audit_trail_file.settings:events. The base audit_trail module supplies the tamper-evidence.
